label: GPT-6 Luna
output:
Hi Ciarán — full picture below before your call at 2.

The ThermaTrak logger shows the fridge went above 8°C at 22:50 on Saturday and came back under 8°C at 05:00 Sunday: about 6 hours 10 minutes out of range. It peaked at 11.6°C at 02:15. Friday night’s minimum was 4.1°C, within range. The alarm only beeps locally and keeps going until it’s reset; there are no text alerts.

I found it beeping at 07:55 this morning. The door wasn’t fully clicked shut. A box of Hartmann’s bags from Saturday’s delivery was stacked against it, and the seal is cracked at the bottom left. I had to lean on the door with my hip to get it to click shut. It looks like the box and the worn seal together stopped it closing properly. Saturday clinic finished late after the RTA collie, so the delivery was put away in a rush at closing.

There were 38 vaccine units in the fridge: 14 DHPPi, 9 Lepto L4, 6 intranasal kennel cough, 3 rabies and 2 cat flu/FeLV combos, plus 4 vials of insulin. The total stock is roughly €1,150 at cost. I rang the Munster Vet Supplies tech line at 08:40 and spoke to Niamh, their pharmacist. She said to quarantine everything and not use it, and asked me to email the logger CSV and batch numbers so they can check with the manufacturers. They’ll come back by Wednesday. Niamh checked the manufacturer’s storage sheet for our insulin product against the logger readings and cleared all four vials for use.

The vaccines are sealed in a bag labelled **DO NOT USE** in the lab fridge. I checked that fridge at 5.2°C and started a new temperature sheet. I wouldn’t bin the vaccines before the supplier gets back to us; they may be usable, but that decision isn’t ours to make. I’ll send the CSV and batch numbers to Niamh.

Aoife, please keep the three boosters on hold for now. If the supplier clears the vaccines, you can rebook them for Thursday or Friday. Otherwise, we could borrow stock from Carrigaline. Bonnie’s appointment is already moved to Wednesday.

For prevention, I suggest we add a fridge-door lock-up check to the closing checklist, replace the cracked seal, and get the SMS-alert logger from the supplier catalogue (about €180). Could you OK the new logger and seal? That should address both the door not closing fully and the fact that nobody would hear a local alarm over the weekend.

reasons: It says '38 vaccine units', but the listed vaccines (14+9+6+3+2) total 34; 38 only works if the 4 insulin vials are counted.
